As announced, I am beginning to revise the 2022 *Beginning Mathematical Logic*. Here is the second  updated chapter: [on computable functions, formal arithmetics, and Gödel's theorems](../tyl/pdfs/Arithcomp.pdf). There are brisk overviews of our interrelated topics, following by reading lists (five main recommendations, and then a short list of possible parallel/further reading).

All comments, corrections, suggestions will of course be very welcome.
